goal: CONTROLLED single-variable diff of CP-CONV-02: identical pedestal-Franka + high-z sensor/cube/end-stop, but a GENERATED create_conveyor belt (top 1.781) instead of the real A09 asset. Isolates whether the real-asset belt vs the pedestal/high-z is the breaker of the pick-controller.
thoughts: If this generated-belt variant PICKS -> the real A09 asset belt was the breaker. If it ALSO fails (plan_calls=0) -> the pedestal base z=1.4 / high-z (~1.8m) pick+sensor is the breaker, independent of the belt asset. Either way isolates CP-CONV-02 #52 in ONE controlled run.
code:
# CP-CONV-02 v3: COMPLETE real-conveyor PICK CELL. Real A09 belt (motion + end-stop pick-zone, both proven) +
# a PEDESTAL Franka (base z=1.4, reach_validate REACHABLE) picking the presented cube into a bin. v3 matches the
# PROVEN CP-CHAIN-FLAT sensor-pick EXACTLY: belt_path=None (a STATIC sensor-triggered pick on the cube the belt
# holds against the end-stop; v1/v2 set belt_path to the REAL belt -> plan_calls=0, the belt-pick code path does
# not trigger off a raw conveyor asset) + size=0.05 + sleepThreshold=0 + rubber. The belt still carries the cube
# (surface-velocity is independent of belt_path). cont.319w.
create_scene_baseline(include_ground=True, table_size=[2.0, 1.0])

create_conveyor(prim_path="/World/GenBelt", position=[-0.5, 0.0, 1.756], size=[3.0, 0.9, 0.05], surface_velocity=[0.2, 0.0, 0.0])
create_prim(prim_path="/World/EndStop", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.03, 0.0, 1.80], scale=[0.01, 0.1, 0.02])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/EndStop", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.0, -0.7, 0.7], scale=[0.25, 0.25, 0.7])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

robot_wizard(robot_name="Franka", dest_path="/World/Franka", position=[0.0, -0.7, 1.4], orientation=[0.7071, 0.0, 0.0, 0.7071])

# Cube at the pick-zone (the belt holds it against the end-stop = effectively static). Proven cube setup.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Cube", position=[-0.05, 0.0, 1.806], size=0.05)
for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name=api)
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
bulk_set_attribute(prim_paths=["/World/Cube_1"], attr="physxRigidBody:sleepThreshold", value=0.0)
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", material_name="rubber")

create_bin(prim_path="/World/Bin", position=[0.0, -1.25, 1.45], size=[0.3, 0.3, 0.12])

add_proximity_sensor(sensor_path="/World/PickSensor", position=[-0.005, 0.0, 1.83], size=[0.10, 0.10, 0.08])

setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/Franka",
    target_source="curobo",
    sensor_path="/World/PickSensor",
    belt_path=None,
    source_paths=["/World/Cube_1"],
    destination_path="/World/Bin",
    planning_obstacles=["/World/EndStop", "/World/Pedestal", "/World/Bin"],
)
